title: Flat-RLVR: Sharpness-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Reasoning Capacity in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is highly effective at enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it commonly induces \textit{distribution sharpening}, whereby the policy distribution becomes excessively peaked and rare-yet-correct trajectories are progressively suppressed, thus diminishing sample diversity. To this end, we promote flat-reward optima in RLVR to smooth the policy distribution. We theoretically link flat reward RLVR to reduced distribution sharpening, and empirically show improved sample diversity while maintaining single-attempt accuracy. translated_title: Flat-RLVR：面向大语言模型推理能力的基于可验证奖励的锐度感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），特别是通过组相对策略优化（GRPO），已成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心范式。虽然RLVR在增强大语言模型的推理能力方面非常有效，但它通常会引发“分布锐化”现象，即策略分布变得过度尖锐，那些罕见但正确的轨迹被逐步抑制，从而降低了样本多样性。为此，我们在RLVR中促进平坦的奖励最优值以平滑策略分布。我们从理论上将平坦奖励的RLVR与分布锐化的减少联系起来，并在实证上展示了在保持单次尝试准确率的同时改善了样本多样性。我们的方法称为Flat-RLVR，在大语言模型后训练过程中通过锐度感知最小化来搜索平坦的奖励区域，并将其与GRPO变体相结合，以在……之间实现更好的权衡（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出Flat-RLVR方法，通过锐度感知最小化在RLVR中寻找平坦奖励区域，缓解分布锐化问题，在保持准确率的同时提升大语言模型的样本多样性和推理能力。
en_tdlr: Flat-RLVR searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization in RLVR to mitigate distribution sharpening, improving sample diversity while maintaining reasoning accuracy in LLMs.
